meta.title: Usage Board
meta.description: DeepSeek balance, 7-day/30-day spend totals and a 7-day daily trend, plus GLM Coding Plan, Kimi Code and OpenCode Go 5-hour, weekly (and monthly) quota windows, together in one DSH sidebar panel using the four official APIs; services without a configured credential show no card. The usage_query tool lets the model read the same usage, quota and balance.
